Incident outer harbor, Havre outer harbor, Havre (6th

claims.citation: New York Herald, 22 August 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
STEAMSHIP WM PENN (Br), from London for New York
via Havre, on entering the latter port morning of the 6th
inst, run aground in the outer harbor, but got off same after-
noon apparently without injury.
